breakdown.description: Funds 18+ public schools, over 11,000 students, teacher salaries, special education programs, facilities maintenance, and student transportation.

components.name: Regular Instruction & Classrooms
components.description: Teacher salaries, classroom supplies, textbooks, educational tech

components.name: Employee Health & Pension Benefits
components.description: State medical/dental benefits, employer statutory pensions, FICA

components.name: Special Education & Out-of-District Tuition
components.description: Mandated specialized instruction, therapy, and out-of-district placements

components.name: Operations, Facilities & Plant Maintenance
components.description: Building upkeep, custodial staff, heating, utilities, repairs

components.name: Student Transportation
components.description: District busing, contracted transportation routes, fuel

components.name: School & District Administration
components.description: Superintendent, business office, principals, supervisors, legal, audit

components.name: Student Support Services & Extracurriculars
components.description: Guidance counselors, social workers, nurses, athletics

breakdown.description: Funds local municipal operations including police, fire, public works, sanitation, municipal court, health services, and the public library ($143.3M total CY 2026 adopted budget).

components.name: Police Department & Public Safety
components.description: Patrol, detectives, emergency dispatch, equipment, vehicles

components.name: Fire Department & Emergency Medical Services
components.description: Firefighters, fire prevention, apparatus, EMS response

components.name: Statutory Pensions & Employee Benefits
components.description: Police & Firemen's Retirement System (PFRS), PERS, health insurance

components.name: Department of Public Works (DPW)
components.description: Road maintenance, trash/recycling, snow removal, tree trimming, parks

components.name: Municipal Debt Service & Capital Improvements
components.description: Bond repayments, interest, infrastructure bond funds

components.name: General Administration, Legal & Finance
components.description: City Manager, Clerk, Tax Assessor, Tax Collector, City Attorney, IT

components.name: Health, Human Services & Public Library
components.description: Health inspections, senior center, clinic, Clifton Public Library

breakdown.description: Clifton's apportionment of the Passaic County budget, which funds county roads, the Sheriff's Office, county corrections, parks, and Passaic County Community College.

components.name: Passaic County Sheriff & Corrections
components.description: County jail operations, courthouse security, sheriff patrols

components.name: Passaic County Road & Bridge Infrastructure
components.description: County roads (e.g. Clifton Ave, Paulison Ave, Van Houten), traffic signals

components.name: County Health, Social Services & Welfare
components.description: Board of Social Services, youth shelter, senior services

components.name: County Judiciary & Constitutional Officers
components.description: Superior Court operations, County Clerk, Surrogate, Prosecutor's Office

components.name: County Parks & Open Space
components.description: Garret Mountain Reservation, Weasel Brook Park, recreation

components.name: Higher Education Support (PCCC)
components.description: Passaic County Community College operating & capital share
